chunks: When the angels said: 'O Mary, God gives you news of a word from Him, whose name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, illustrious in this world and the next, and among the honored.'

key_terms.فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ: In this world and the Hereafter
key_terms.كَلِمَةٍ: Word (referring to Jesus as a word from God)

ai.seo_question: What are the key titles and statuses given to Jesus (Isa) in this verse regarding his birth and divine favor?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'Kalimah' (Word) is interpreted not merely as a title but as a creative command of God, emphasizing Isa's miraculous creation without a father while maintaining his human nature. The designation 'Wajihan' underscores his dual prominence in both the temporal realm and the spiritual hierarchy, while 'Muqarrabin' links him to the highest tier of prophets and angels, reflecting his unique proximity to the Divine Will.
